name: Zettai Shiawase Sengen!
source:
Kei has a childhood friend, Aya, who always dangles around him. She often says something like this, "I've found a way to make people happy!". He enjoys his school life. But, he sometimes thinks, "What do I wanna do after all...?" It's a school love story....

[From ErogeShop.com]
